expect_red: an open dimension wears its drawing's status as one chip in its grid row and its Preview, each status its own words

mutations.contract: The grid row of an open dimension wears the chip where its number would be.
mutations.note: Declared by handoff an_open_dimension_says_where_its_drawing_stands (2026-11-19). Drops the grid row's chip.

mutations.contract: The Preview of an open dimension wears the chip.
mutations.note: Declared by handoff an_open_dimension_says_where_its_drawing_stands (2026-11-19). Drops the Preview's chip.

mutations.contract: `unknown` claims nothing: it wears no chip.
mutations.note: Declared by handoff an_open_dimension_says_where_its_drawing_stands (2026-11-19). Gives `unknown` words of its own.

mutations.contract: The record carries the edge's status.
mutations.note: Declared by handoff an_open_dimension_says_where_its_drawing_stands (2026-11-19). The record drops it.
